tasks.title: Serve exact per-location uptime over 90 UTC days with repairable daily tallies
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, all Behavior and Checks bullets, Tool facts and Completion evidence; Decisions 1-2; Counterexamples (Location uptime window, Statistic, Sorting and uniqueness, Complete-day rule, Status codes of the route); Performance impact; Security impact; Rollout order. One task owns the whole tally lifecycle, rather than separating stages of its algorithm: additive table without user_version change, conditional ingest upsert, aggregate-day fill followed by transactional location-day repair using the sum-of-location-total completeness rule, current-day bounded query, UTF-16 location ordering, cache/invalidation, public route/metric, yielding cancellable backfill with counted location days, and expired/orphan retention. Pin the merged contract main SHA in package.json and bun.lock. Update all listed endpoint, concepts, operation and README documentation, including downgrade/rebuild semantics. Counterexamples (Ids `.` and `..`): pin existing normalized routing with a literal raw node:http request; document that per-id routes cannot address these ids, without changing routing.

acceptance.command: bun test src/location-uptime.test.ts src/server.location-uptime.test.ts src/uptime-rollup.test.ts src/retention.test.ts src/db.test.ts
acceptance.expected: All selected tests pass, 0 fail; focused coverage may fail the global threshold. With injected now 2026-11-05T12:00:00Z, 2026-08-08T00:00:00.000Z counts, 2026-08-07T23:59:59.999Z and 2026-11-05T12:00:00.001Z do not. More than 100 rows at 2 locations are counted over the full window independently of result paging; a separate eu fixture with 3 up/1 degraded/1 down yields good 4/results 5/uptime 80, an old-only us yields 0/0/null, all-down yields 0%, and heartbeat is included. Location names are unique and sorted B,a,b. Counts agree with aggregate /uptime at the same now; existing uptime/SLO retain their meaning.

exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass at the existing 80% line coverage gate. Real-server tests validate 200 with validateCheckLocationUptime, 404 unknown/inactive, 400 bad escape with error 'bad check id', encoded a/b ids, public access even with an irrelevant Bearer header, and metric label /checks/:id/location-uptime. Method handling follows the existing public read routes. Storage tests prove unchanged user_version and reopen compatibility; a closed day whose location totals are 9 versus uptime_daily.total 10 repairs, a complete day of 10 avoids a raw-history recompute, deleted location-day rows repair, a late accepted result updates the next uncached response exactly once, and today/unfilled days do not get ingest rollups. Backfill yields after each check/day, stops when asked and logs location-day counts; retention removes old/orphan location rows. Include new-test failures on fb6f1a5 (404 route/missing table), passing output, and Security impact evidence for this public read, error/metric safety, validation and full contract pin in the PR. With a fixture check '.' and results, a node:http request with literal path /checks/%2E/location-uptime answers 404 with literal body {"error":"not found"}, and raw /checks/../results answers 405; these baseline routing assertions already pass on fb6f1a5. HEAD returns 200 without a body for an active check. Docs include the dot-id limit.

exit 0 under the harness's independent default wall-time limits: cold checks/uptime/concurrent each below 400 ms, end-of-day checks below 392 ms and latency below 53 ms. Record measured Performance impact keys in the PR; these are the spec's allowed local alternative to the full main-versus-branch bench. Also time GET /checks/c0/location-uptime on a separate 864000-row 1x seed, once before location backfill and once after it, and report both measured durations without inventing a new budget.

With temporary PULSE_DB/checks.json and 2 probe tokens configured as in Completion evidence, the real API starts; submit 1 up result for eu and 1 down result for us within the window, each POST /results returns 204, then curl /checks/<id>/location-uptime returns 200 with windowDays 90, eu good 1/results 1/uptime 100 and us good 0/results 1/uptime 0. Record the actual start, POST and curl commands plus redacted output in the PR; no token or private fixture value is published.
